P3B-B-EVAL-ST-TRIM_DUPLICATE_LOWER-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
SENTENCE low=strings.LOWER(strings.TRIM(text," ")).
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.CONCAT(low,"a"),low)).
P3B-B-EVAL-FI-CONTAINS_SELECT-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
IF (strings.CONTAINS(left,"a")) { DISPLAYNL(strings.UPPER(right)). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(strings.LOWER(left)). }
P3B-B-EVAL-FI-WEIGHTED_FIELD_COUNT-01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
DISPLAYNL(2*strings.COUNT(left,"a")+strings.COUNT(right,"a")+1).
